messages:
marta: Quick heads-up — I updated the Q3 RICE sheet with suggested numbers for 'Adaptive Routing v1'. Link: https://docs.google.com/sheet/EXAMPLE Please react with :thumbsup: or post adjustments by EOD. TL;DR: a couple enterprise customers asked for routing controls, but infra cost + perf tradeoffs are non-trivial.

sam: Quick read — reach looks understated. Our telemetry shows ~8k routing-touch requests/day; monthly active would be closer to 40k. Recommend updating reach.

elaine: I pushed new impact numbers (enterprise conversion uplift estimate). Impact=7, confidence=60% based on two pilots.

tariq: From infra: MVP core routing ~6w (effort estimate 4), adding canary hooks + per-tenant controls ~2w extra (effort ~1.3). Can we consider splitting: core routing (fast path) + advanced policies (phase 2)?

marta: I like the split. Quick off-the-cuff calc: if we split, core might have R:40k I:5 C:70 Effort:3 -> RICE ~= (40k*5*0.7)/3; if we keep monolith R:60k I:7 C:50 Effort:6 -> RICE ~= (60k*7*0.5)/6. Appears split has higher RICE.

sam: Can you paste the numbers/formula?

marta: ```RICE_core = (40000 * 5 * 0.7) / 3 = 46666
RICE_full = (60000 * 7 * 0.5) / 6  = 35000```

elaine: That math checks out. Two caveats: (1) several customers explicitly asked for policy UI at launch — that reduces confidence if we ship core-only, (2) potential SLO regressions if routing adds latency. We should add explicit launch criteria.

roadmap-bot: Board updated — 'Adaptive Routing v1' moved to candidate. Owner: marta. Due date: 2025-09-30.

marta: Proposed acceptance criteria: 1) Canary on 3 pilot customers with rollback path, 2) p95 latency delta <= 50ms, 3) regression tests + prompt eval set showing no quality drop. If these fail, fallback to stateless routing. Thoughts?

sam: Agree. Also suggest reserving a small Dedicated pool for canary so we can measure realistic perf under load.

tariq: Will add detailed effort/epic split in the ticket: core routing epic (owner: tariq), policy engine epic (owner: elaine), integration + telemetry (owner: sam). Adding KMS and per-tenant throttles as checkboxes.

marta: Good. We'll take the split path for prioritization. I'll update the RICE sheet and flag this for tomorrow's triage so the prioritization board reflects the split scoring. Thanks all :thumbsup:

(reacts: :eyes: from ela ine, :rocket: from sam)
